about.title: About
about.faq1q: How do I configure AI providers?
about.faq1a: Add a provider API Key in "Settings → Models & Services", then pick the model from the model list.
about.faq2a: WeChat Work, Feishu and DingTalk delivery are supported; choose one in the scheduled task delivery settings.
about.faq3a: Check updates under "Me → Current Version" and follow the prompts to download and install.
about.faq4a: Personal data is stored and computed independently to keep your account data secure.
about.faq5q: How do I report an issue?
about.faq5a: Submit feedback in the app, or contact GWork support.
